shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts components/AppProvider.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' styles/globals.css; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'find . -name AGENTS.md -print && git status --short && git log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && ls -la && find public -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files app components lib styles | sort && sed -n '1,80p' app/layout.tsx && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rmdir pages/blog pages/api/posts pages/api pages components 2>&1 || true
rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)|NextApi(Request|Response)|pages/\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' --glob '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' . || true
find . -maxdepth 4 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './__agent_eval__/*' | sort
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "set -e
curl -sS -D /tmp/home.headers -o /tmp/home.body http://localhost:3000/
curl -sS -D /tmp/blog.headers -o /tmp/blog.body http://localhost:3000/blog
curl -sS -D /tmp/post.headers -o /tmp/post.body http://localhost:3000/blog/1
curl -sS -D /tmp/missing.headers -o /tmp/missing.body http://localhost:3000/definitely-missing
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-list.headers -o /tmp/api-list.body http://localhost:3000/api/posts
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-create.headers -o /tmp/api-create.body -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"New\",\"content\":\"Body\"}' http://localhost:3000/api/posts
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-invalid.headers -o /tmp/api-invalid.body -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{}' http://localhost:3000/api/posts
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-one.headers -o /tmp/api-one.body http://localhost:3000/api/posts/7
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-update.headers -o /tmp/api-update.body -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Changed\"}' http://localhost:3000/api/posts/7
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-delete.headers -o /tmp/api-delete.body -X DELETE http://localhost:3000/api/posts/7
for name in home blog post missing api-list api-create api-invalid api-one api-update api-delete; do code="'$(awk '"'NR==1 {print "'$2}'"' \"/tmp/"'$name.headers"); size=$(wc -c < "/tmp/$name.body"); printf '"'%s %s %s bytes\\n' \""'$name" "$code" "$size"; done
for name in api-list api-create api-invalid api-one api-update api-delete; do printf '"'%s: ' \""'$name"; cat "/tmp/$name.body"; printf '"'\\n'; done
rg -o '<title>["'^<]+'"' /tmp/home.body /tmp/blog.body /tmp/post.body /tmp/missing.body"

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json styles/globals.css && git diff --stat && git status --short && test ! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory absent' && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)|NextApi(Request|Response)\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' --glob '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' . || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && test ! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory absent' && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)|NextApi(Request|Response)\" app components lib styles next.config.ts || true && find app components lib -type f | sort"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --numstat && git diff -- .gitignore tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && rg -n '\"next\"' package-lock.json | head"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build && git status --short && test ! -d pages'
